user_query: entries in the trass.stories database about international launch

intent.goal: find entries about international launch in the Trass Games stories database

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.title,
u.created_time,
u.database_name,
g.message_content,
g.subject,
g.body_snippet 
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
LEFT JOIN generic_content gc ON u.page_id = gc.page_id
WHERE u.workspace = 'trass'
AND (
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%international%' 
    OR LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(g.body_snippet) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(gc.title) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(gc.title) LIKE '%launch%'
    OR LOWER(gc.metadata) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(gc.metadata) LIKE '%launch%'
)
LIMIT 5000
